# ex: match involving function type signatures
ex {
	var f func(int) string
	f(1) -> f(2)
}
-- x.go --
package m

func F() string {
	g := func(n int) string { return "" }
	return g(1)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@

 func F() string {
 	g := func(n int) string { return "" }
-	return g(1)
+	return g(2)
 }
